Technology stocks were softer in recent trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 Thursday losing more than 1.1% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was plunging almost 2.3%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) SeaChange International ( SEAC ) Thursday was more than 4% higher although the television and video accessories company reported Q2 results that missed expectations. Q3 is seen in line.
In other sector news:
(+) Cloudera ( CLDR ) raced as much as 23% higher on Thursday on better-than-expected Q2 results and solid guidance.
(+) Cubic ( CUB ) was back on positive ground Thursday afternoon, recovering from a fractional mid-morning decline, after its Cubic Mission Solutions division received orders worth more than a combined $55 million to deliver its inflatable satellite communication and networking systems to the U.S. Army.
